description: Sidequest Syndicate org-wide Renovate preset. Auto-discovered by Mend as the named org preset (`<org>/.github:renovate-config`). Repos can also extend it explicitly via `github>sidequest-syndicate/.github:renovate-config`.

packageRules.description: Group GitHub Actions minor/patch/digest into one weekly PR; auto-merge on green CI
GitHub Actions major bumps stay individual and require human review

Ignore @types/node major bumps org-wide. @types/node tracks the Node runtime types; every Sidequest repo pins the Node engine in package.json#engines, so a @types/node major (e.g. ^22 → ^25) types in APIs that aren't on the runtime. Revisit when a repo updates its engine pin.

Ignore TypeScript major bumps org-wide. TS majors have transitive type-package fallout (Pulumi types, AWS SDK types, framework types) and need a coordinated review, not a one-line Renovate PR. File a deliberate upgrade PR when ready.

Ignore pnpm/action-setup major bumps. The action's major version is tied to a default pnpm version (v6 → pnpm 11), but every Sidequest repo pins pnpm via `packageManager` in package.json. Bumping the action major without regenerating pnpm-lock.yaml produces ERR_PNPM_BROKEN_LOCKFILE.
